ai_summary: Rajshree Polypack Limited reported strong Q1 FY2027 consolidated results, with revenue from operations increasing by 24.7% year-over-year to ₹10,291.06 lakhs and net profit surging by 77.7% to ₹725.68 lakhs. A significant red flag is the non-recognition of ongoing substantial losses (₹86.95 lakhs this quarter) from its jointly controlled entity, Olive Ecopak Private Limited, as the company's investment in the JV has been fully impaired, potentially masking further underlying performance issues.
